info.title: AMLOK API
info.description: API reference for AMLOK 1.4.2, with example requests and responses. Configure your institution-issued environment URL before making requests.

servers.description: Set the server URL to your institution-issued AMLOK environment URL.

get.description:
List authorized connection records.

Required scope: `connections:read`. Source, module, country, consent and contracted permissions determine population.

parameters.name: X-Request-ID
parameters.description: Optional caller correlation ID; the response includes AMLOK request_id.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Default 100, maximum 200.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque AMLOK cursor. Preserve the original filters.

parameters.name: subject_id
parameters.description: Filter to one authorized business or person where applicable.

parameters.name: updated_from
parameters.description: Inclusive normalized update time.

parameters.name: updated_to
parameters.description: Exclusive normalized update time.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by this resource status.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated relative fields. Required identity and metadata remain.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated optional expansions: provenance, missing_fields. No unrestricted graph traversal.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:
curl --request GET --fail-with-body --max-time 30 \
  "${AMLOK_API_BASE_URL}/v1/connections" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer ${AMLOK_API_KEY}" \
  --header "Accept: application/json"

import os
import requests

base_url = os.environ["AMLOK_API_BASE_URL"].rstrip("/")
headers = {'Accept': 'application/json'}
headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + os.environ["AMLOK_API_KEY"]

response = requests.request(
    "GET", base_url + "/v1/connections",
    headers=headers, timeout=30, allow_redirects=False,
)
response.raise_for_status()
print(response.json())

post.description:
Start an authorized source-connection flow.

Required scope: `connections:write`. Return a short-lived authorization action; no provider secret in response.

parameters.name: X-Request-ID
parameters.description: Optional caller correlation ID; the response includes AMLOK request_id.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Reuse for retries of the same intended command and identical payload. Retention: 24 hours.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:
curl --request POST --fail-with-body --max-time 30 \
  "${AMLOK_API_BASE_URL}/v1/connections" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer ${AMLOK_API_KEY}" \
  --header "Accept: application/json" \
  --header 'Idempotency-Key: idem_example_1001' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
  "subject_id": "biz_example",
  "provider_id": "BANK-02",
  "products": [
    "transactions"
  ],
  "consent_id": "con_example",
  "redirect_uri": "https://client.example.com/connected"
}'

import os
import requests

base_url = os.environ["AMLOK_API_BASE_URL"].rstrip("/")
headers = {'Accept': 'application/json',
 'Idempotency-Key': 'idem_example_1001',
 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + os.environ["AMLOK_API_KEY"]

response = requests.request(
    "POST", base_url + "/v1/connections",
    headers=headers, timeout=30, allow_redirects=False,
    json={'subject_id': 'biz_example',
 'provider_id': 'BANK-02',
 'products': ['transactions'],
 'consent_id': 'con_example',
 'redirect_uri': 'https://client.example.com/connected'},
)
response.raise_for_status()
print(response.json())

parameters.name: X-Request-ID

curl --request POST --fail-with-body --max-time 30 \
  "${AMLOK_API_BASE_URL}/v1/documents" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer ${AMLOK_API_KEY}" \
  --header "Accept: application/json" \
  --header 'Idempotency-Key: idem_example_1001' \
  --form 'file=@statement-2026-09.pdf' \
  --form 'subject_id=biz_example' \
  --form 'document_type=bank_statement' \
  --form 'period_start=2026-09-01' \
  --form 'period_end=2026-09-30'

import os
import requests

base_url = os.environ["AMLOK_API_BASE_URL"].rstrip("/")
headers = {'Accept': 'application/json',
 'Idempotency-Key': 'idem_example_1001'}
headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + os.environ["AMLOK_API_KEY"]

with open("statement-2026-09.pdf", "rb") as file:
    response = requests.post(
        base_url + "/v1/documents", headers=headers,
        files={"file": ("statement-2026-09.pdf", file, "application/pdf")},
        data={'subject_id': 'biz_example',
 'document_type': 'bank_statement',
 'period_start': '2026-09-01',
 'period_end': '2026-09-30'},
        timeout=30, allow_redirects=False,
    )
response.raise_for_status()
print(response.json())

x-codeSamples.source:
curl --request POST --fail-with-body --max-time 30 \
  "${AMLOK_API_BASE_URL}/v1/wallet-closures/res_example/cancel" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer ${AMLOK_API_KEY}" \
  --header 'If-Match: "1"' \
  --header "Accept: application/json" \
  --header 'Idempotency-Key: idem_example_1001' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
  "reason": "Keep this wallet."
}'

import os
import requests

base_url = os.environ["AMLOK_API_BASE_URL"].rstrip("/")
headers = {'Accept': 'application/json',
 'Idempotency-Key': 'idem_example_1001',
 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + os.environ["AMLOK_API_KEY"]

headers["If-Match"] = '"1"'
response = requests.request(
    "POST", base_url + "/v1/wallet-closures/res_example/cancel",
    headers=headers, timeout=30, allow_redirects=False,
    json={'reason': 'Keep this wallet.'},
)
response.raise_for_status()
print(response.json())
